prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” attorney for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on your case facts (severity of injuries, who’s at fault, insurance issues, whether you need a trial lawyer, language needs, budget). That said, Chicago has many highly regarded personal-injury firms that handle car-accident claims. A few well-known plaintiff firms you can start with are:

- Clifford Law Offices
- Levin & Perconti
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard
- Power Rogers & Smith

How to pick the best attorney for your case
- Experience: look for lawyers who focus on car-accident/personal-injury work and have trial experience for serious cases.  
- Track record: ask about case results and settlements/verdicts for similar injuries.  
- Reputation: check client reviews, Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell ratings, and local bar referrals.  
- Communication: confirm who will handle your case day-to-day and how often you’ll get updates.  
- Fees: most personal-injury lawyers work on contingency (commonly ~33%–40% of recovery). Ask about costs and when you’ll owe them.  
- Availability: get a free consultation and compare 2–4 lawyers before deciding.

Questions to ask at the free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the results?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?  
- What’s your fee structure and who pays case costs?  
- Do you expect to settle or take the case to trial?  
- How long will this likely take?  
- Any potential problems you see with my claim?

Practical and legal deadlines
- Illinois generally has a 2-year statute of limitations for personal-injury suits, so act promptly. (If a government entity is involved there are different/shorter notice requirements.)  
- Preserve evidence, get medical care, collect police and insurance info, and avoid giving recorded statements to insurers before talking with an attorney.

If you’d like, tell me:
- Date of the accident, severity of injuries, and whether the other driver’s insurer has contacted you — I can suggest 3 attorneys/firms in Chicago to contact (with phone/website) and help you draft questions for their consultations.
